title: Lantern Brigade
description: Recruit lantern-bearing heroes, merge triples into starred upgrades, set a 2x3 formation and auto-battle through ten stages to topple the Ash Lantern-Eater.
controls: Tap a shop card to recruit, tap or drag a hero onto a slot to move it, then press Fight. Three copies of a hero merge automatically. Reroll costs 1 gold.

zh-CN.title: 提灯旅团
zh-CN.description: 招募提灯英雄，三个同名自动合成升星，排好 2×3 阵型自动对战，闯过十关击败灰烬噬灯兽。
zh-CN.controls: 点商店卡片招募，点选或拖动英雄换格子，再点出战；三个同名同星英雄自动合成；刷新花 1 金币。
